svg.aria-label: Rift, a Mountebank-compatible HTTP and HTTPS mock server. Requests reach an imposter and are checked against its stubs in order; the first stub whose predicates match answers with the next response in its cycle, 200 v1 and then 200 v2. A request no hand-written stub matches reaches a proxyOnce proxy stub, which forwards it upstream and records the answer as a new stub in front of itself; the next identical request is replayed from that recording without calling upstream.
